Author: Proteu
Name: Ultimate Rotation Guide
Punchline: Shows one player's ability order from an FFLogs ultimate pull.
Description: Loads one job's public FFLogs rDPS parses for an ultimate, grouped by percentile, and shows that player's ability order. In the selected ultimate, the guide starts at the pull and follows the fight, and it resets if you leave or wipe. Automatic rotation is off until you enable it. It then presses each due step for you, including on a striking dummy. The settings window has Parses, Actions, and Rotation pages. The guide stays on the Rotation page. Start on countdown presses the current step at the end of the countdown's 1, while that number is still showing. The loaded parse is a queue split by fight part. UseAction is sent only after the animation lock has cleared. A GCD is sent only in the last half-second of its recast. An oGCD is woven as soon as that lock opens, once its step time is reached, and does not wait for the GCD. The game keeps one queued press. A rejected press is tried again. The queue advances only when the cast happens. A late skill does not push the following steps back by extra seconds. The next part starts on its own log time and is not played early. A step on cooldown is held until the press can succeed. Before the first skill of the pull is used, a step is not skipped and a different press is not marked. After that skill, a step with no gauge or resource is skipped. After that skill, pressing any later skill in the current part marks the skipped steps with an X and continues from that skill, including when automatic rotation is off. The GCD stays the held button. A queued press is not replaced. When Checkmate or Double Check is the oGCD step and that action is not ready, the other is pressed if it is ready, only once the step's time has arrived. GCDs are not swapped. Show skills, on the Rotation page, draws an icon for each step beside the text list and highlights the step being used. Detach, at the top of that timeline, opens the icons in their own window. Attach brings them back. Actions shows each ability as an icon. A bright icon may be used, and a dimmed icon is skipped. Mitigations and Gemdraught stay off until you enable them. Opener training, on the Rotation page, shows The Balance opener for the selected job in the same timeline. After its first skill, a later press marks the skipped steps with an X and jumps the queue.
